summary: France localization of Business Central 29. It covers payment management with payment slips, RIB bank keys, SIREN/SIRET company data, fiscal period and year closing, FEC and XML audit exports, accelerated (derogatory) depreciation, VAT paid on debits, Intrastat/DEB and service declarations. It answers where French-specific behavior sits in code and on Learn.
overview:
The French layer adds 283 objects of its own and changes many W1 objects. The largest block is payment management: payment classes, statuses, steps, slips, archives and payment addresses, with codeunits such as "Payment Management" (10860) and "Payment-Apply" (10861). It sits next to FR variants and a feature switch checked through Feature Key Management. Bank, customer and vendor bank accounts get RIB fields (Agency Code, RIB Key, RIB Checked).

Finance changes cover fiscal periods and years (Fiscally Closed, Fiscal Closing Date, Period Reopened Date on Accounting Period), posting date ranges on General Ledger Setup, G/L entry application (Applies-to ID, Letter, Letter Date), delayed unrealized VAT in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, and audit exports in FEC and XML formats. Fixed assets get derogatory (accelerated) depreciation through new fields, posting procedures and reports. Company Information carries SIRET No., APE code, legal form and trade register data, and Contact carries SIREN No. with the same company data.

Sales adds VAT Paid on Debits, shipment-to-invoice linking, and French trial balance and journal reports. Intrastat objects with Obligation Level and CISD support DEB reporting, and separate local service declaration objects handle service declarations. Learn covers these topics in France pages, most with the [FR] suffix, and in the France local functionality overview. That overview also mentions a move to an extensions-based model in 2026 release wave 2 and e-invoicing with UBL 2.1, Factur-X and E-Reporting FR. Learn notes that the local G/L entry application is being deprecated in favor of a base app feature.
key_points: Payment management: payment classes, statuses, steps, slips, archives, payment addresses and export of payments by report or XMLport; setup parameters can be exported and imported.
RIB fields (Agency Code, RIB Key, RIB Checked) on bank, customer bank and vendor bank accounts, with RIB Key codeunits.
Fiscal periods and years: close and reopen periods, fiscal year closing, two open fiscal years, posting allowed from/to in General Ledger Setup.
FEC export for tax audits with opening balances, plus a general ledger XML export, both built on the audit file export framework.
Accelerated depreciation: derogatory depreciation book fields, FA posting group accounts, derogatory calculation and projected value reports.
VAT Paid on Debits on sales documents, SIREN No. on Customer, Vendor and Contact, and SIRET validation on Company Information.
G/L entry application with Letter and Letter Date (Learn says it is being deprecated in favor of a base app feature), and French customer and vendor journals and trial balances.
Intrastat for DEB with Obligation Level and CISD, and a separate local service declaration export.

areas.what: Adds the French payment management module: payment classes, statuses, steps, slips, archives, payment addresses and bank pages, with FR and base-named page and codeunit pairs. Bank Account gets RIB fields and National Issuer No. SEPA direct debit codeunits get events for payment lines, and the Check report gets French amount-in-words procedures.
areas.why: Learn describes payment slips as the way to manage customer and vendor payments and to generate payment files for the bank.

areas.what: Changes Gen. Jnl.-Post Line for delayed unrealized VAT and derogatory entries, and adds fields to Gen. Journal Line, G/L Entry and General Ledger Setup. Adds FEC and XML audit export codeunits with page extensions, G/L entry application, fiscal year closing and French account schedules.
areas.why: Learn documents fiscal closing, posting period limits, FEC export for tax audits and G/L entry application for French accounting.

areas.what: Adds VAT Paid on Debits to sales headers and posted invoices and credit memos, SIREN No. on Customer, and payment reporting fields. Adds shipment-invoice linking (Shipment Invoiced table and two pages), Sales-Post event, French customer journal and trial balance reports, and changes to standard sales invoice reports.
areas.why: Learn describes SIREN No. and VAT Paid on Debits as French sales invoice specifics.

areas.what: Implements accelerated (derogatory) depreciation: fields on depreciation book, FA depreciation book and FA posting group, new procedures in disposal, ledger entry and depreciation codeunits. Adds professional tax on Fixed Asset and French book value and projected value reports.
areas.why: Learn explains that accelerated depreciation posts the difference between tax and accounting depreciation books.

areas.what: Supports Intrastat reporting for the Declaration of Trade in Goods: filter codeunits for receipts and shipments, an Obligation Level enum, and extensions on the Intrastat report and Company Information. Shipment Method Code is added to item ledger and item journal lines.
areas.why: Learn lists CISD, obligation levels and transaction specification filters as requirements for DEB reporting.

areas.what: Adds SIREN No., payment in progress and payment reporting exclusion to Vendor, RIB fields to Vendor Bank Account, and a Due Date on Payable Vendor Ledger Entry. Adds French vendor journal and trial balance reports.

Company Information gets trade register, APE code, legal form, stock capital, SIRET and CISD fields, with SIRET validation procedures. Accounting Period gets fiscal closing fields and procedures, and DateFilter-Calc gets period checks. Country/Region gets a SEPA Allowed field.
areas.why: Learn documents period closing and reopening using Fiscally Closed, Fiscal Closing Date and Period Reopened Date.

areas.what: Mostly upgrade plumbing, plus a permission set for payment management (FR-PMS), a source code extension and an Employee Marital Status enum.
Adds local service declaration management and export codeunits, with setup page and wizard extensions and a permission set extension.
Adds a feature management codeunit for Sales FR and a procedure in Feature Key Management that tells whether payment management is enabled.
Changes the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets to include French objects.
Contact gets trade register, APE code, legal form, stock capital and SIREN No., with procedures to keep the customer SIREN in sync.
Adds an Expense Event Subscriber FR codeunit for the expense agent.
Adds a Marital Status field to Employee.

issues: The overview says Intrastat and service declaration objects together support DEB reporting. In the Learn input, DEB is the Declaration of Trade in Goods, which is handled by the Intrastat objects (Obligation Level, CISD). The local service declaration objects are a separate feature.
The overview says Learn documents each topic in pages with the [FR] suffix. Several pages in the input have no such suffix, for example 'Export entries for tax audits' and 'How to Export Payments'.
The text leaves out that Learn describes the local G/L entry application as being deprecated in favor of a base app feature. This is useful context for the Letter and Letter Date key point.
The overview mentions the move to an extensions-based model but not its timing. Learn places it in 2026 release wave 2.

Small point: 'Company Information and Contact carry SIREN, SIRET...' is true only for the two objects taken together. Company Information has SIRET No. and a GetSIREN procedure, and Contact has the SIREN No. field.
